error_word_conflict_duplicate_any.message: Another word is already spelled like that, with the same meaning.
error_word_conflict_duplicate_any.description: Slice 25 error (code word_conflict): an edit would make two words alike, when the language name isn't known.

error_storage_full_blocked.message: Kotiko is still open in a tab from before an update. Close Kotiko's other tabs, then try again.
error_storage_full_blocked.description: Slice 25 error (code storage_full): the word store is held open by an older page.

error_storage_full_unavailable.message: This browser won't let Kotiko keep words here. Private windows can do this; open Kotiko in a normal window.
error_storage_full_unavailable.description: Slice 25 error (code storage_full): the browser refused to open the word store.

error_storage_full_deleted.message: Everything Kotiko kept in this browser was just deleted. Open Kotiko again to start fresh.
error_storage_full_deleted.description: Slice 25 error (code storage_full): after 'Delete everything', until an extension page is opened again.

error_copy_details.description: Button inside an error's Details: copies the error code, technical details, Kotiko's version and the browser's, never words.

error_copied.description: Shown on the Copy details button after copying.

dash_set_reading.description: Settings section title (slice 27 §2): how swapped words are read by screen readers and reached with the keyboard.

dash_screen_reader.message: Screen readers hear swapped words as
dash_screen_reader.description: Settings → Reading (slice 27 §2): label of the choice of what a screen reader reads on a swapped word.

dash_screen_reader_target.description: Settings → Reading: screen readers read the swapped word, in its own language's voice (the default).

dash_screen_reader_original.description: Settings → Reading: screen readers read the page's own word instead of the swapped one.

dash_screen_reader_both.description: Settings → Reading: screen readers read the swapped word, then the page's own word.

dash_screen_reader_help.message: The word you're learning is read in its own language's voice. To hear its meaning, use Show details on it (Alt+Shift+R unless you changed it).
dash_screen_reader_help.description: Help under the screen-reader choice when it reads the word being learned. Alt+Shift+R is the default shortcut (slice 33).

dash_screen_reader_page_text.message: Sites can read this text: the page's own word goes back into the page, hidden, next to each swapped word.
dash_screen_reader_page_text.description: Help under the screen-reader choice when it reads the original word, or both (slice 27 §2): the original text is put back into the web page's code.

dash_keyboard_swaps.message: Let me Tab to swapped words
dash_keyboard_swaps.description: Settings → Reading (slice 27 §2): switch that makes every swapped word on a page a Tab stop.

dash_keyboard_swaps_help.message: Each swapped word becomes a stop for the Tab key, and Enter shows its details. Off by default, because a long page gets a stop for every word Kotiko swapped.

dash_swap_controls_warning.message: Voice control commands that use button names may stop working.
dash_swap_controls_warning.description: Warning under the buttons-and-menus switch while it is on (slice 27 §5, WCAG 2.5.3): a swapped word in a button's name breaks commands like “click Send”.

connect_working.description: On the docs site's "Connect OpenRouter" return page (kotiko.org/connect/, slice 11 §4), while Kotiko trades the sign-in for a key.

connect_done.message: Connected. Kotiko now looks words up with OpenRouter's free models. You can close this tab.
connect_done.description: On the docs site's "Connect OpenRouter" return page, once the key is saved.

connect_expired.message: This sign-in has expired. Open Kotiko's settings and select Connect OpenRouter again.
connect_expired.description: On the docs site's "Connect OpenRouter" return page, when the sign-in was started more than 10 minutes ago or was already used. Keep "Connect OpenRouter" as the button says it.

connect_failed.message: Kotiko couldn't finish connecting to OpenRouter. Try again from Kotiko's settings, or paste a key there instead.
connect_failed.description: On the docs site's "Connect OpenRouter" return page, when OpenRouter didn't give a key or something else went wrong.

welcome_ai_waiting.message: Waiting for OpenRouter… Finish signing in on the other tab.
welcome_ai_waiting.description: Welcome tab, under Connect OpenRouter while OpenRouter's sign-in tab is open (slice 22 §4).

dash_connect_openrouter.description: Settings, Word lookups, with OpenRouter chosen: opens OpenRouter's sign-in in a new tab; the key arrives without copying it (slice 11 §4).

dash_connect_openrouter_help.message: Sign in to OpenRouter in a new tab and Kotiko gets a key, with nothing to copy. Or paste a key below.
dash_connect_openrouter_help.description: Settings, Word lookups: next to Connect OpenRouter (slice 11 §4).

dash_connect_waiting.message: Waiting for OpenRouter… Finish signing in on the other tab.
dash_connect_waiting.description: Settings, Word lookups: status line while OpenRouter's sign-in tab is open (slice 11 §4).

dash_connect_done.description: Settings: short notice when the Connect OpenRouter sign-in finished in the other tab (slice 11 §4).
